title: BajPack
description: A simple modpack that focuses on client-side visual improvements and QOL features.
body:
![Voxy panorama](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2736e4b17858226b82851876e17efebc9d18b343_0.webp)

A simple modpack made for Forsen's 24/7 anarchy server that focuses on client-side visual improvements and QOL features.


Visual/decorative mods include:
- Punchy
- Iris
- Voxy
- Sounds
- Subtle Effects
- Immersive UI
- and a few others

Main QOL mods are:
- Mouse tweaks
- Inventory Profiles Next
- Xaero's Minimap/World Map
- Chat Patches
- Loot Journal
- Build Guide
- Chest Tracker

Many of these mods can be configured or disabled through the mod list.

There are also a few resource packs that are enabled by default.
